paragraphs: Lendable’s ambition to deliver instant credit and savings solutions mirrors my recent work on a fast, agentic tool that delivers real‑time decision support for a fintech start‑up. I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo. I wrote a three‑tier test framework of about 65 tests across eight files, validating the LLM provider migration from Groq to AWS Bedrock after a rate‑limit evaluation.
